surface: 402 response envelope (inference path, not a monitoring endpoint)
origin: structure and both discriminator enumerations are documented; the message and remedy_hint strings are SYNTHETIC
notes: OpenRouter publishes one 402 example verbatim, and it pairs limit_source=openrouter_in_flight_budget with reason=in_flight_budget_exhausted. This fixture exercises the OTHER documented limit_source value (openrouter_credits) with the other documented reason (weight_exceeds_budget), so its message and remedy_hint are invented and must not be quoted as provider text. What IS documented and load-bearing is the contract: all three discriminators live under error.metadata, limit_source is one of openrouter_in_flight_budget, openrouter_key_limit or openrouter_credits, and code must branch on limit_source rather than on the prose. openrouter_credits versus openrouter_key_limit is precisely the account-versus-key distinction A04 cares about. A monitoring client does not call inference endpoints, so it should never receive this envelope; it is recorded because a negative account balance can produce these errors even for free models.
